extractor_notes.blockers: Organon is a diversified commercial-stage pharma (women's health, biosimilars, established brands). Recent 8-Ks cover Q4 2025 / Q1 2026 earnings and the pending merger with Sun Pharmaceutical Industries (announced April 2026, all-cash, expected to close early 2027). Recent FDA approvals (e.g., denosumab-nxxp/Jubbonti in Sep 2025) are already commercial. No forward-looking clinical pipeline PDUFA/topline/IND catalysts disclosed in 8-K Ex-99.1 earnings PRs.
